Name: RUNEWORK
Main Effect:
You learn to inscribe spells on your own skin. Only a spell that targets yourself or something you can touch can be inscribed, and an inscribed spell cannot be Overcast or Multicast.

Whenever you take a Long Rest, you can use your Long Rest action to inscribe one spell, to remove one, or both.

You cannot inscribe the same spell twice.

Inscribing a spell permanently reduces your maximum Willpower by that spell Willpower cost. Removing the rune gives it back.

At Rank 1 you inscribe Novice Spells, at Rank 3 Adept Spells, and at Rank 5 Master Spells.

Name: RUNE ACTIVATION
Main Effect:
Once a round, you can fire one of your inscribed spells for 1 Action Point and no Willpower.

A fired rune cannot be fired again until you take a Long Rest.

Name: RECHARGED
Main Effect: Whenever you take a Short Rest, you can bring back any number of fired runes whose Willpower costs add up to no more than your Physique.

Name: RUNIC NETWORK
Main Effect:
You can pay the Upkeep on up to 2 spells at once when you cast them through your runes.

Your maximum Willpower is increased by half your Physique.

Name: INSTINCTIVE ACTIVATION
Main Effect: Firing a rune no longer costs an Action Point, and you can fire 2 runes a round instead of 1.

Name: STREAMLINED PATTERNS
Main Effect: Your maximum Willpower is increased by your full Physique instead of half of it.
